relevance_note: Case report of a male with a LAMP2 variant: 'a novel frameshift mutation (c.1052delG) has been identified in exon 8 of LAMP2'.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script in my scratch directory assembled the JSON and checked every span verbatim. Scope: the proband III-1 (LAMP2 c.1052delG), relatives described in relation to him (mother II-2 and maternal grandmother I-2, both affected with 'heart disease' but not tested; father, uncle II-3 and cousin III-2, who tested negative for the mutation and had normal ECG and echocardiography; no variant rows for these tested-negative relatives, their negative result is in the proband's parental_testing_statement for the father), and three previously published 928G > A patients given individual-level facts in the Discussion (refs [30], [42], [43]). Bertini [42] is described as 'cases' (plural) but with one age; recorded as one person, which may merge more than one. Arad [43] gives only 'a typical triad of DD'; number of people unclear, recorded as one. Table 1 lists mutation sites per exon by ancestry (Asian n = 26, Caucasian n = 26) without patient identifiers, references or per-person data; its entries were not treated as individuals and no rows were created for them. Gene for the literature variants is not printed in the same sentence; span uses the abstract's LAMP2 sentence. 928G > A is printed without a 'c.' prefix and is recorded as printed. Normal ECG and echocardiography in relatives recorded as excluded 'abnormal electrocardiogram'/'abnormal echocardiography' only (D-27); no checklist items excluded from them. Burusnukul [30] 'normal cardiac evaluation' recorded as excluded 'abnormal cardiac evaluation' only. Cardiomegaly is hedged ('Chest X-ray suggested'). Inheritance left 'not reported': father negative, mother not tested. Cause of death for the proband not stated explicitly (he died within 24 h of readmission with congestive heart failure and cardiogenic shock); left 'not reported'. Mother's age at death not printed (diagnosed at 24, died 2 years later); deceased_age left null. Contradictions: the proband is called 'a male patient in early adolescence' but also '18 years old'; the Discussion says 'her father' for the male proband. HCM in ref [42] and the 'typical triad' in ref [43] were not mapped to checklist items. PASP 70 mmHg recorded as a measured finding without calling it pulmonary hypertension (the paper does not).
